properties.name: logging.loggers.http.enabled
properties.description: Enable logging for HTTP requests and responses.

properties.name: logging.loggers.http.log-response
properties.description: Log HTTP responses. If set to 'true', the response body will be logged.

properties.name: logging.loggers.http.log-authorization-header
properties.description: Log the Authorization header in HTTP requests. If set to 'true', the header will be logged.

properties.name: logging.loggers.method.enabled
properties.description: Log method calls. If set to 'true', method entry and exit will be logged.
